title: Berkeley Lab Sensors Enable First Light for the Dark Energy Camera
version: 2012-09-17. Contemporary supplier announcement with contributions described by Natalie Roe and Stephen Holland.
lineage: Contemporary supplier announcement with contributions described by Natalie Roe and Stephen Holland.

passages.locator: Paragraphs beginning ‘Early in the planning’, ‘Manufacture’, and ‘The DECam chips’
passages.note: Berkeley Lab connects DECam's 250 μm chips to its mid-1990s detector work, identifies Holland's supervision of their manufacture, and describes the split between Teledyne DALSA, Berkeley Lab and Fermilab. The body of the article correctly identifies the Blanco as 4 m; one caption disagrees.
